environment_adaptation.reason: The host virtualizes getpid but /proc/self/exe is accessible. Official Lean executable-location lookup used /proc/<getpid>/exe.
environment_adaptation.scope: Only readlink of the caller numeric executable path is redirected to /proc/self/exe; other paths are passed unchanged. This changes no Lean source, theorem, kernel checks or admitted axioms.
environment_adaptation.used_as: LD_PRELOAD=/tmp/nabt_lean_proc_path.so for lake/lean build and audit commands
environment_adaptation.normal_environment: Do not use this adapter where the official toolchain already locates its executable correctly.
